about: The jobs Kit to Clip can recognise. A card (toolbox/cards/<id>.json) names the capabilities it provides. Every capability has a fallback that works with nothing extra installed. Words are what a person might say; the router matches meaning, not exact words.

families.footage: work on real video and photos
families.quality: checks that protect the viewer and the brand

video-render.about: draw a video from HTML and code, frame by frame
video-render.fallback: none: this is the engine itself (setup)

timeline-motion.about: choreographed motion: reveals, staggers, transitions, kinetic type
timeline-motion.fallback: none needed: built into the engine

text-effects.about: named text animations: typewriter, scramble, split reveals, per-letter effects
text-effects.fallback: GSAP SplitText recipes in the engine

shader-background.about: living gradients, grain, liquid and noise backgrounds in brand colours

particles.about: thousands of particles, confetti, sparks, dust, GPU filters
particles.fallback: a few dozen DOM or canvas particles with GSAP

generative-art.about: generative patterns and painted, brush or pencil looks

hand-drawn.about: sketchy, whiteboard, hand-drawn shapes and lines
hand-drawn.fallback: SVG strokes drawn on with GSAP

physics.about: objects that fall, bounce, pile up or collide believably (simulated once, then baked)

lottie-play.about: play a Lottie or dotLottie animation inside a video
lottie-play.fallback: none needed: built into the engine

lottie-theme.about: recolour or re-text a stock Lottie to the brand
lottie-theme.fallback: edit colours in the Lottie JSON by hand

3d.about: 3D scenes in the browser (logos, products, cameras)
3d.fallback: none needed: built into the engine (Three.js)

3d-render.about: heavy 3D: modelling, physics, cinematic lighting, rendered offline

logo-convert.about: turn .ai, .eps or .pdf logos into clean SVG we can animate
logo-convert.fallback: ask the brand for an SVG or a large PNG

path-simplify.about: reduce jagged or heavy vector paths to smooth curves
path-simplify.fallback: use the paths as they are

image-trace.about: trace a PNG or JPG logo into vector shapes
image-trace.fallback: use the image as it is (no draw-on effects)

svg-to-layers.about: turn an SVG into animatable layers in a layered motion project
svg-to-layers.fallback: animate the SVG in the browser

brand-from-website.about: read colours, fonts and logos from a live website

footage-edit.about: cut, trim, reorder, zoom, constant speed and speed ramps on real clips
footage-edit.fallback: none needed: built into the engine

frame-exact-edit.about: frame holds anywhere, exact retimes and edits a video editor would make
frame-exact-edit.fallback: still frames extracted with ffmpeg and placed in the video

timeline-export.about: hand an editor a timeline file (FCPXML, EDL, OTIO) to re-cut by hand
timeline-export.fallback: the finished video plus a list of cut times

cutout.about: remove the background from a photo or frame (people, products, logos)
cutout.fallback: use the image with its background, or a soft mask

video-mask.about: follow a person or object through a clip with a mask (text behind the player, spotlight)
video-mask.fallback: text in front, or a cutout on a frozen frame

slow-motion.about: smooth slow motion by inventing frames between frames

upscale.about: make a small or soft image or clip sharper and bigger
upscale.fallback: use it at its own size

video-link-read.about: read a video link: transcript, frames and the file

music.about: background music made on the computer in a few styles

music-generate.about: an original song-like track from a description (genre, mood, tempo)

sound-effects.about: whooshes, hits and risers placed on the motion, in key

voice-over.about: a spoken voice reading a script
voice-over.fallback: on-screen text instead of a voice

transcribe.about: speech to text with timings: captions, transcript cuts
transcribe.fallback: type the words in by hand

beat-sync.about: find the beats and put cuts and motion on them

lottie-export.about: deliver an animation as a Lottie or dotLottie file for websites and apps
lottie-export.fallback: WebM with transparency, APNG or the live snippet

editable-project.about: a layered project a designer can open and adjust by hand
editable-project.fallback: the HTML project itself, with notes

platform-finish.about: safe areas, loudness, share copies and covers per platform

flash-guard.about: catch flashing that can harm viewers (WCAG: at most 3 flashes a second)

reduced-motion.about: a calm still or fade version of web loops for people who turn motion off
